title: Erased, But Not Forgotten: Erased Rectified Flow Transformers Still Remain Unsafe Under Concept Attack
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark did not measure any aspects of faith or religion. The focus was on the robustness of concept erasure in text-to-image models, specifically concerning NSFW content (nudity, violence), artistic styles, entities, and celebrities.
findings: The paper's findings are not related to religion. It introduces a concept attack method, ReFlux, demonstrating that erased concepts in rectified flow transformer models (like Flux) can be effectively restored. This indicates that current concept erasure techniques are not robust and primarily suppress concepts at a surface level, leaving deeper semantics intact and vulnerable to reactivation. The attack was evaluated on NSFW content, artistic styles, and other specific concepts.
